# reselling_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

A managed Kubernetes cluster. Worker pools are `worker_pool` blocks, matched by name: new pools are added, removed pools deleted and changed sizes or labels updated in place (a changed plan or CPU pool replaces that pool). A new `version_id` starts an upgrade. Deleting marks the cluster for deletion with a 48 hour grace period.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_kubernetes_versions" "all" {}
data "reselling_kubernetes_plans" "all" {}

resource "reselling_kubernetes_cluster" "main" {
  name                  = "main"
  location_id           = data.reselling_locations.fra.locations[0].id
  cluster_id            = data.reselling_locations.fra.locations[0].clusters[0].id
  version_id            = data.reselling_kubernetes_versions.all.default_id
  control_plane_plan_id = [for p in data.reselling_kubernetes_plans.all.plans : p.id if p.is_control_plane][0]
  control_plane_count   = 3
  vpc_id                = reselling_vpc.backend.id

  worker_pool {
    name                      = "workers"
    plan_id                   = [for p in data.reselling_kubernetes_plans.all.plans : p.id if !p.is_control_plane][0]
    infrastructure_cluster_id = data.reselling_locations.fra.locations[0].clusters[0].id
    min_nodes                 = 2
    max_nodes                 = 5
    auto_scale                = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Hardware cluster (CPU pool) of the control plane.
- `control_plane_plan_id` (String) Control plane plan (see `reselling_kubernetes_plans`).
- `location_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Letters, digits and hyphens. Changed in place.
- `version_id` (String) Kubernetes version (see `reselling_kubernetes_versions`). A newer version upgrades the cluster in place.

### Optional

- `auto_upgrade` (Boolean)
- `control_plane_count` (Number) 1 or 3 (highly available).
- `maintenance_day` (Number) 0-6 (0 = Sunday).
- `maintenance_hour` (Number) 0-23.
- `pod_cidr` (String)
- `service_cidr` (String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC of the nodes; one is created when not set.
- `worker_pool` (Block List) Worker node pool; at least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--worker_pool))

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) API server endpoint.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version string.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedblock--worker_pool"></a>
### Nested Schema for `worker_pool`

Required:

- `infrastructure_cluster_id` (String) Hardware cluster (CPU pool) of the nodes.
- `max_nodes` (Number)
- `min_nodes` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `plan_id` (String) Worker plan.

Optional:

- `auto_scale` (Boolean)
- `label_key` (String)
- `label_value` (String)

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `node_count` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_kubernetes_cluster.main <cluster_id>
```
